parts:
Hi Benjamin,

That seems reasonable to me - but you could simplify your code to

test.files <- dir("BI_test_files", full.names = TRUE)

Hadley

On Thu, Aug 2, 2012 at 1:05 PM, Benjamin Petersen <bnjmn...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Hello, devtools group.
>
> What's the correct way for loading external test data into the testing
> environment? All the examples I've seen for creating test data within
> testthat/devtools have source code generating datasets or reference data
> included in the package.
>
> I'm writing a package to standardize the ingestion of some .csv files that
> our company software produces. Reading in the files properly is part of the
> package so it doesn't really make sense to pre-load the datasets into the
> package environment.
>
> Right now, within each test_that test file (.R) I am source()ing a file that
> loads the test file names as relative paths. This seemed to be the only way
> I could get the paths to work with both check(), test() and
> test_file("tests/test-all.R").
>
> Is there a better way?
>
> -------------------------------
> This is the file that is sourced from within the same directory
> (pkg/inst/tests/) with a subdirectory containing all the .csv files for
> testing.
>
>
> # Load test files
> test.dir <- "./BI_test_files/"
> test.files <- list.files( test.dir )
> test.files <- paste(test.dir, test.files, sep="")
>
